fields.notes: LoRaWAN's protocol-level DFT surface is the DevStatus/LinkCheck MAC commands, gateway-reported RSSI/SNR, CAD, and server-side MIC/FCnt counters. Chip-level scan/BIST is an integrator concern.

in_band_test_facilities.name: RSSI / SNR reporting
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-frame signal quality reported by the gateway/network server.

in_band_test_facilities.name: Channel Activity Detection (CAD)
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Low-power preamble detection for channel probing.

in_band_test_facilities.name: MIC / FCnt counters
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Integrity-failure and replay telemetry at the server.

internal_diagnostics_observability: Negotiated data rate (SF/BW), TX power, channel mask.
out_of_band_test_facilities: LoRa Alliance Certification test harness (join, ADR, MAC commands, RX timing, class behaviors).

extraction_hints: Look for scan / DFT / BIST / JTAG sections.
